'''Werewolves''' can be found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]]. They have better defence and accuracy than their [[Werewolf|counterparts]] in [[Canifis]], and are also aggressive to players not wearing an item of [[Zamorak]]. They are spread out all over the dungeon, are most prevalent in [[Zamorak's Fortress]], but are not found in [[Bandos's Stronghold]]. Werewolves can be killed here for a Slayer assignment, but this is not recommended due to the remoteness and danger.
